name: magpie-agy-acp
description: Multi-account Antigravity CLI (agy acp) model provider plugin for Magpie and OpenCode

summary.en: Runs your locally installed agy CLI via official `agy acp --worker` (downloads nothing) with isolated multi-account sign-in: browser OAuth, remote callback-URL paste, Switcher/CLIProxyAPI token import, or one-click adoption of your existing local agy login, without touching OS Keychain. Unlike `antigravity` (direct internal HTTP client), sessions run through the real agy binary; unlike `agy-cli` (single OS Keychain login and PATH `nc` wrapper), it adds quota-aware multi-account failover (5h/weekly windows + Pro/Ultra badges), native loopback HTTP MCP tool bridging, automatic image downscaling, and session retention when historical media expires. Shares the same Google Antigravity quota pool per account with `antigravity` and `agy-cli`.
summary.zh: 通过官方 `agy acp --worker` 运行你本机已安装的 agy CLI（不下载任何附加服务端），提供独立隔离的多账号登录：支持浏览器 OAuth、远程回调链接粘贴、Switcher/CLIProxyAPI 令牌批量导入，或一键接管本机现有 agy 登录，不占用系统钥匙串。相比直接请求内部 HTTP 接口的 `antigravity`，它走真实官方 agy 进程；相比仅支持系统钥匙串单账号且通过 PATH 注入 `nc` 脚本桥接的 `agy-cli`，它新增了基于配额感知的多账号自动切换（5 小时/周窗口与 Pro/Ultra 标识）、原生本地 HTTP MCP 工具桥接、大图自动压缩以及历史图片过期后的会话保留能力。同一 Google 账号与 `antigravity`、`agy-cli` 共享相同的 Google Antigravity 额度池。
